_comment: LINEDOWN — GENUINE reference marking fixture for the APPROVED WINNER (beat 6).
Present so the demo can show that the part we actually bought has a clean, complete marking
record — not just that the broker's lot was dirty. It is also the low-similarity control in
the beat-5 match (0.18 against the suspect lot), which demonstrates the matcher discriminates
ILLUSTRATIVE: marking strings, lot codes and serial ranges are plausible and format-correct
but fabricated. Not transcribed from real Samsung parts.
MODULE vs DIE: describes markings on a complete 288-pin RDIMM assembly. The component part
number under `dramPackageTopMarking` is recorded because it is what is physically printed on
the packages — NOT because anything here substitutes die.

moduleLabel.substrate: white polyimide adhesive label, heat-spreader mounted

dramPackageTopMarking.surfaceFinish: uniform moulded epoxy, no abrasion, consistent gloss

validators.note: Assembly site CHINA is legitimate for this manufacturer. Country of origin alone is never a counterfeit indicator — it is only evidence when it contradicts the manufacturer's published sites for the specific SKU, which is how it is used in finding F1/F3 of the suspect fixture, not as a standalone red flag.

plain: The part we actually bought. Laser-burned codes, a traceable serial number, a working tracking code, and every date agreeing with every other date.
